    AAC (Advanced Audio Coding)

    Parameters:

    channel_order int | None | Literal['default', 'coded']

    Order in which the channels are to be exported (from 0 to 1) (default default)

    target_level int | None

    Name Type Description Default
    conceal int | None | Literal['spectral', 'noise', 'energy']

    Error concealment method (from 0 to 2) (default noise)

    		 None
    drc_boost int | None

    Dynamic Range Control: boost, where [0] is none and [127] is max boost (from -1 to 127) (default -1)

    		 None
    drc_cut int | None

    Dynamic Range Control: attenuation factor, where [0] is none and [127] is max compression (from -1 to 127) (default -1)

    		 None
    drc_level int | None

    Dynamic Range Control: reference level, quantized to 0.25dB steps where [0] is 0dB and [127] is -31.75dB, -1 for auto, and -2 for disabled (from -2 to 127) (default -1)

    		 None
    drc_heavy int | None

    Dynamic Range Control: heavy compression, where [1] is on (RF mode) and [0] is off (from -1 to 1) (default -1)

    		 None
    level_limit bool | None

    Signal level limiting (default auto)

    		 None
    drc_effect int | None

    Dynamic Range Control: effect type, where e.g. [0] is none and [6] is general (from -1 to 8) (default -1)

    		 None
    album_mode int | None

    Dynamic Range Control: album mode, where [0] is off and [1] is on (from -1 to 1) (default -1)

    		 None
